response.overview: **SPIDER-MAN: GRAVEYARD**  Peter Parker thought he’d finally left the mask behind. Living quietly with his wife Gwen, he has traded the streets of New York for the safety of home—until Tombstone comes knocking.  A mysterious green pendant, tied to a buried chapter of Tombstone’s past, brings the crime boss straight into Peter’s home. With no suit, no warning, and nowhere to run, Peter is forced to become Spider-Man again—but this time, there’s no city to save.  It’s just his home. His wife. His secret.  And Tombstone isn’t leaving without the pendant.  As the night closes in, Peter must decide how far he’s willing to go to protect the life he built—and whether the man beneath the mask is still the hero he once was.  **Some things are buried for a reason.**
response.tagline: SOME THINGS ARE BURIED FOR A REASON.
response.title: SPIDERMAN GRAVEYARD
